title: Plumeform band backdrop (v2)
description: The full-bleed layer behind a dark band: a slot for a background video, WebGL scene or image (cropped like object-fit: cover), with an optional dark veil for legible text. Empty, it is a plain dark surface with a soft teal glow wash. It fades in on load or as it scrolls into view.
notes: place it inside a relative, isolated parent; it sits at z-index -10 and fills it
the empty state is a placeholder for the original's fluted-glass canvas
name: plumeform-v2-backdrop

props.name: media
props.description: a video, canvas or image filling the band; empty shows the placeholder

props.name: entrance
props.description: fade in once on page load (hero) or as the band scrolls into view

props.name: veil
props.description: darken the middle and the edges so text on top stays readable
